jyutping: mou4 leon6 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 gei2 daai6 doi6 gaa3

english.note: Use this fixed phrase specifically for “whatever the cost,” meaning regardless of how great a price must be paid.

examples.english: Whatever the cost, I have to save him.
examples.traditional: 無論要付出幾大代價，我都要救返佢。
examples.jyutping: mou4 leon6 jiu3 fu6 ceot1 gei2 daai6 doi6 gaa3 ngo5 dou1 jiu3 gau3 faan1 keoi5
